mapper.sql: cta.*, c.course_code as courseCode, c.course_name as courseName, c.term as term, t.teacher_name as teacherName, r.room_name as roomName
from class_time_apply cta left join course c on cta.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on cta.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join room r on cta.room_id = r.id
